property_summary: For every call to play() with msg.value less than or equal to the ticket amount, the reference contract requires exactly TICKET_AMOUNT, so any call that completes always increases pot by exactly TICKET_AMOUNT when msg.value == TICKET_AMOUNT and never accepts msg.value == 0 — the mutant using >= allows zero-value plays that do not increase pot and can change post-play pot, violating the invariant that after any admissible play the pot either increased by TICKET_AMOUNT or was reset only when a full ticket was paid and winner path executed.
change_summary: Change the required msg.value so play accepts 0 or 10 by using >= instead of ==, which allows calls that don't increase pot and thus can change resulting pot observed after play.
